name: create-skill
tagline_zh: 在 Cherry Studio 里说一句“造个新技能”，它自动搭骨架、查规范、同步仓库。不用读文档，不用手写配置。
tagline_en: Say "make a skill" in Cherry Studio—it scaffolds, validates, and syncs. No docs, no config, from zero to working.
desc_en: Create a new skill in the current repository. Use when the user wants to create/add a new skill, or mentions creating a skill from scratch. This skill follows the workflow defined in .agents/skills/README.md and helps scaffold, validate, and sync new skills.
why_zh: 同类工具只生成模板，它按仓库内 README 流程走完校验和同步，确保新技能直接可用，不烂尾。
why_en: Unlike template-only generators, it follows the repo's own workflow to validate and sync, so your skill is production-ready, not.
